name: 아
soundEn: Like 'a' in 'father'.
hint: The short line points right, away from the stem: 'ah', as in 'far'.

name: 어
soundEn: Like 'u' in 'sun' or 'o' in 'son'. Mouth open, lips relaxed and not rounded.
soundRu: No exact Russian match. Start from «о» and relax your lips so they are not rounded.
hint: The short line points left. Open your mouth wider than for ㅗ.

name: 오
soundEn: Like 'o' in 'go', but short, with clearly rounded lips.
soundRu: Close to «о», with the lips clearly rounded.
hint: The short line points up: 'o', as in 'over'.

name: 우
soundEn: Like 'oo' in 'moon'.
hint: The line points down: 'oo', as in 'root', growing downward.

name: 으
soundEn: No English match. Say 'oo', then spread your lips flat as in a tight smile.
soundRu: Close to «ы», said a little further back in the mouth.
hint: A flat line for flat lips.

name: 이
soundEn: Like 'ee' in 'see'.
hint: A tall line, like a tree: 'ee'.

name: 야
soundEn: Like 'ya' in 'yard'.
hint: A second short line adds a 'y' sound: ㅏ (a) becomes ㅑ (ya).

name: 여
soundEn: Like 'yu' in 'yum'.
soundRu: No exact match: «й» plus the open ㅓ sound. It is not «ё», which is closer to ㅛ.
hint: A second short line adds a 'y' sound: ㅓ (eo) becomes ㅕ (yeo).

name: 요
soundEn: Like 'yo' in 'yoga', but short.
hint: A second short line adds a 'y' sound: ㅗ (o) becomes ㅛ (yo).

name: 유
soundEn: Like the word 'you'.
hint: A second short line adds a 'y' sound: ㅜ (u) becomes ㅠ (yu).

name: 기역
soundEn: Between 'g' and 'k', with almost no puff of air. Closer to 'k' at the start of a word, closer to 'g' between vowels.
soundRu: Between «г» and «к». At the start of a word it is close to a soft «к».
hint: Looks like a gun: g.

name: 니은
soundEn: Like 'n' in 'no'.
hint: Looks like a nose seen from the side: n.

name: 디귿
soundEn: Between 'd' and 't', with almost no puff of air.
hint: Looks like a door frame: d.

name: 리을
soundEn: Between vowels: one quick tap of the tongue, like the 'tt' in American 'butter'. At the end of a syllable: a light 'l'.
soundRu: Between vowels: a single-tap «р», never rolled. At the end of a syllable: a light «л».
hint: Looks like a winding road: r / l.

name: 미음
soundEn: Like 'm' in 'map'.
hint: A square, like a closed mouth: m.

name: 비읍
soundEn: Between 'b' and 'p', with almost no puff of air.
hint: Looks like a bucket: b.

name: 시옷
soundEn: Like 's' in 'sun'. Before ㅣ and the y-vowels (ㅑ ㅕ ㅛ ㅠ) it sounds like 'sh': 시 is 'shi'.
soundRu: Like «с». Before ㅣ it becomes soft, close to «щ»: 시 sounds like «щи».
hint: Looks like a mountain peak: s, as in 'summit'.

name: 이응
soundEn: Silent at the start of a syllable, where it only holds the place before a vowel. At the end of a syllable it is 'ng', as in 'song'.
soundRu: At the start: no sound. At the end: 'ng', the same sound as Kazakh «ң».
hint: A circle is a zero: zero sound at the start.

name: 지읒
soundEn: Between 'j' in 'jam' and 'ch', with almost no puff of air.
soundRu: Close to a soft «дж», or «ч» with no breath.
hint: Like ㅅ with a lid on top: j.

name: 히읗
soundEn: Like 'h' in 'hat'. Often very weak between vowels.
soundRu: A light breath like English 'h'. Softer than «х».
hint: A person wearing a hat: h.

name: 치읓
soundEn: Like 'ch' in 'church', with a strong puff of air.
soundRu: Like «ч» followed by a strong breath.
hint: ㅈ with an extra stroke on top: the extra stroke is extra air.

name: 키읔
soundEn: Like 'k' in 'kite', with a strong puff of air.
soundRu: «к» plus a breath, like «кх». Stronger than a Russian «к».
hint: ㄱ with an extra stroke: the extra stroke is extra air.

name: 티읕
soundEn: Like 't' in 'top', with a strong puff of air.
hint: ㄷ with an extra stroke: the extra stroke is extra air.

name: 피읖
soundEn: Like 'p' in 'pie', with a strong puff of air.
hint: Looks like the Greek letter π (pi): p.

name: 쌍기역
soundEn: A tense 'k' with no puff of air, like the 'k' in 'sky'. Tighten your throat and release sharply.
soundRu: Very close to a firm Russian «к», which also has no puff of air.
hint: Two ㄱ side by side: double strength, zero air.

name: 쌍디귿
soundEn: A tense 't' with no puff of air, like the 't' in 'stop'.
soundRu: Very close to a firm Russian «т».
hint: Two ㄷ side by side: double strength, zero air.

name: 쌍비읍
soundEn: A tense 'p' with no puff of air, like the 'p' in 'spy'.
soundRu: Very close to a firm Russian «п».
hint: Two ㅂ side by side: double strength, zero air.

name: 쌍시옷
soundEn: A tense, sharp 's'. Before ㅣ it is a tense 'sh'.
hint: Two ㅅ side by side: a stronger s.

name: 쌍지읒
soundEn: A tense 'j' with no puff of air.
soundRu: Close to a firm «ч» with no breath at all.
hint: Two ㅈ side by side: double strength, zero air.

name: 애
soundEn: Like 'e' in 'bed'. In modern speech ㅐ and ㅔ sound the same.
hint: ㅏ + ㅣ written together.

name: 에
soundEn: Like 'e' in 'bed'. It sounds the same as ㅐ for most speakers, so the spelling is learned word by word.
hint: ㅓ + ㅣ written together.

name: 얘
soundEn: Like 'ye' in 'yes'. A rare letter.
hint: ㅑ + ㅣ written together.

name: 예
soundEn: Like 'ye' in 'yes'. After a consonant it is often said as a plain 'e'.
hint: ㅕ + ㅣ written together.

name: 와
soundEn: ㅗ and ㅏ said quickly as one sound: 'wa'.
hint: ㅗ + ㅏ written together.

name: 왜
soundEn: Like 'we' in 'wet'. ㅙ, ㅚ and ㅞ sound almost the same.
hint: ㅗ + ㅐ written together.

name: 외
soundEn: Like 'we' in 'wet'. Despite the spelling, it is not said 'o-i'.
hint: ㅗ + ㅣ written together, but read 'we'.

name: 워
soundEn: Like 'wo' in 'wonder'.
soundRu: «уо» said as one syllable, ending in the open ㅓ sound.
hint: ㅜ + ㅓ written together.

name: 웨
soundEn: Like 'we' in 'wet'.
hint: ㅜ + ㅔ written together.

name: 위
soundEn: Like 'wee' in 'week'.
hint: ㅜ + ㅣ written together.

name: 의
soundEn: ㅡ then ㅣ said quickly: 'eu-i'. Often simplified: 'i' after a consonant (희 is 'hi'), and 'e' when it is the particle 의 ('of').
hint: ㅡ + ㅣ written together.
